theorem coordinate_marginal {ι : Type*} (i : ι) :

GaussianSeriesFoundation.name: I4Foundation.coordinate_integrable
GaussianSeriesFoundation.literal_source_header:
theorem coordinate_integrable {ι : Type*} (i : ι) :

theorem coordinate_abs_integrable {ι : Type*} (i : ι) :

SpectralWeights.name: I4Weights.productBound_summable
SpectralWeights.literal_source_header:
theorem productBound_summable {a c : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (d : ℕ) :

SpectralWeights.name: I4Weights.productDecay_eq_exp
SpectralWeights.literal_source_header:
theorem productDecay_eq_exp (d : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (k : Fin d → ℤ) :
    productDecay d a k = exp (-a * ∑ i, (k i : ℝ) ^ 2)

SpectralWeights.name: I4Weights.frequency_l1_le_product
SpectralWeights.literal_source_header:
theorem frequency_l1_le_product (d : ℕ) (v : Fin d → ℝ) (hv : ∀ i, 0 ≤ v i) :
    1 + ∑ i, v i ≤ ∏ i, (1 + v i)

SpectralWeights.name: I4Weights.sourceA_pos
SpectralWeights.literal_source_header: theorem sourceA_pos {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) : 0 < sourceA L

SpectralWeights.name: I4Weights.sourceWeight_eq_physical
SpectralWeights.literal_source_header:
theorem sourceWeight_eq_physical (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (k : Fin d → ℤ) :
    sourceWeight d L k = exp (-(∑ i, (sourceC L * (k i : ℝ)) ^ 2) / 2)

SpectralWeights.name: I4Weights.sourceWeight_summable
SpectralWeights.literal_source_header:
theorem sourceWeight_summable (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    Summable (sourceWeight d L)

SpectralWeights.name: I4Weights.sourceZ_pos
SpectralWeights.literal_source_header: theorem sourceZ_pos (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) : 0 < sourceZ d L

SpectralWeights.name: I4Weights.pairedBound_eq_amplitude
SpectralWeights.literal_source_header:
theorem pairedBound_eq_amplitude (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) (k : Fin d → ℤ) :
    pairedBound d L k = Real.sqrt (2 * sourceWeight d L k / sourceZ d L) *
      ∏ i, (1 + |sourceC L * (k i : ℝ)|) ^ 4

SpectralWeights.name: I4Weights.pairedBound_summable
SpectralWeights.literal_source_header:
theorem pairedBound_summable (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) :

SourceFourierSeries.literal_source_header:
theorem modeMajorant_nonneg (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (m : SourceMode d) :

SourceFourierSeries.name: I4Source.modeMajorant_summable
SourceFourierSeries.literal_source_header:
theorem modeMajorant_summable (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    Summable (modeMajorant d L)

SourceFourierSeries.name: I4Source.modeCoefficient_bound
SourceFourierSeries.literal_source_header:
theorem modeCoefficient_bound (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0)
    (m : SourceMode d) (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    |modeCoefficient d L m x| ≤ modeMajorant d L m

SourceFourierSeries.name: I4Source.sourceField_eval_measurable
SourceFourierSeries.literal_source_header:
theorem sourceField_eval_measurable (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    Measurable (fun ω => sourceField d L ω x)

SourceFourierSeries.name: I4Source.sourceMajorant_ae
SourceFourierSeries.literal_source_header:
theorem sourceMajorant_ae (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂sourceLaw d, Summable (fun m => modeMajorant d L m * |ω m|)

SourceFourierSeries.name: I4Source.sourceAbs_uniform_ae
SourceFourierSeries.literal_source_header:
theorem sourceAbs_uniform_ae (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂sourceLaw d,
      HasSumUniformly (fun m x => |modeCoefficient d L m x * ω m|)
        (fun x => ∑' m, |modeCoefficient d L m x * ω m|)

SourceFourierSeries.name: I4Source.sourceField_uniform_ae
SourceFourierSeries.literal_source_header:
theorem sourceField_uniform_ae (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂sourceLaw d,
      HasSumUniformly (fun m x => modeCoefficient d L m x * ω m)
        (sourceField d L ω)

SourceFourierSeries.name: I4Source.sourceField_continuous_ae
SourceFourierSeries.literal_source_header:
theorem sourceField_continuous_ae (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂sourceLaw d, Continuous (sourceField d L ω)

SourceC4.name: I4C4.phaseCLM
SourceC4.literal_source_header: def phaseCLM (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (k : Fin d → ℤ) : (Fin d → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ

SourceC4.name: I4C4.phaseCLM_apply
SourceC4.literal_source_header:
theorem phaseCLM_apply (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (k : Fin d → ℤ) (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    phaseCLM d L k x = phase d L k x

SourceC4.name: I4C4.phaseCLM_norm_le
SourceC4.literal_source_header:
theorem phaseCLM_norm_le (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (k : Fin d → ℤ) :
    ‖phaseCLM d L k‖ ≤ ∑ i, |sourceC L * (k i : ℝ)|

SourceC4.name: I4C4.modeCoefficient_iteratedFDeriv_bound
SourceC4.literal_source_header:
theorem modeCoefficient_iteratedFDeriv_bound (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0)
    (m : SourceMode d) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ 4) (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (modeCoefficient d L m) x‖ ≤ modeMajorant d L m

SourceC4.name: I4C4.sourceField_contDiff_ae
SourceC4.literal_source_header:
theorem sourceField_contDiff_ae (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂sourceLaw d, ContDiff ℝ 4 (sourceField d L ω)

SourceC4.name: I4C4.sourceField_contDiff_affine_ae
SourceC4.literal_source_header:
theorem sourceField_contDiff_affine_ae (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    ∀ᵐ ω ∂sourceLaw d, ∀ (T : (Fin d → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin d → ℝ)) (a : Fin d → ℝ),
      ContDiff ℝ 4 (fun x => sourceField d L ω (a + T x))

SourceGaussianLaw.name: I4SourceGaussian.summable_square
SourceGaussianLaw.literal_source_header:
private theorem summable_square (a : ι → ℝ) (ha : Summable a) :
    Summable (fun i => a i ^ 2)

SourceGaussianLaw.name: I4SourceGaussian.partial_charFun
I4SourceGaussian.charFun_partial_tendsto
SourceGaussianLaw.literal_source_header:
private theorem charFun_partial_tendsto (a : ι → ℝ) (ha : Summable a) (t : ℝ) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun s : Finset ι => charFun ((coefficientLaw ι).map
        (fun ω => ∑ i ∈ s, a i * ω i)) t)
      Filter.atTop (𝓝 (charFun ((coefficientLaw ι).map (scalarSeries a)) t))

SourceGaussianLaw.name: I4SourceGaussian.scalarSeries_map_gaussian
SourceGaussianLaw.literal_source_header:
theorem scalarSeries_map_gaussian (a : ι → ℝ) (ha : Summable a) :
    (coefficientLaw ι).map (scalarSeries a) =
      gaussianReal 0 (∑' i, a i ^ 2).toNNReal

SourceGaussianLaw.name: I4SourceGaussian.scalarSeries_integral_zero
SourceGaussianLaw.literal_source_header:
theorem scalarSeries_integral_zero (a : ι → ℝ) (ha : Summable a) :
    ∫ ω, scalarSeries a ω ∂coefficientLaw ι = 0

SourceGaussianLaw.name: I4SourceGaussian.scalarSeries_variance
SourceGaussianLaw.literal_source_header:
theorem scalarSeries_variance (a : ι → ℝ) (ha : Summable a) :
    Var[scalarSeries a; coefficientLaw ι] = ∑' i, a i ^ 2

SourceGaussianLaw.name: I4SourceGaussian.source_linearCombination_hasGaussianLaw
SourceGaussianLaw.literal_source_header:
theorem source_linearCombination_hasGaussianLaw (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → (Fin d → ℝ)) (c : Fin n → ℝ) :
    HasGaussianLaw (fun ω => ∑ j, c j * sourceField d L ω (x j)) (sourceLaw d)

SourceGaussianLaw.name: I4SourceGaussian.source_finiteVector_hasGaussianLaw
SourceGaussianLaw.literal_source_header:
theorem source_finiteVector_hasGaussianLaw (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0)
    (n : ℕ) (x : Fin n → (Fin d → ℝ)) :
    HasGaussianLaw (fun ω j => sourceField d L ω (x j)) (sourceLaw d)

SourceGaussianLaw.name: I4SourceGaussian.sourceField_isGaussianProcess
SourceGaussianLaw.literal_source_header:
theorem sourceField_isGaussianProcess (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    IsGaussianProcess (fun x ω => sourceField d L ω x) (sourceLaw d)

SourceLattice.name: I4Lattice.latticeFrequency
SourceLattice.literal_source_header: def latticeFrequency (d : ℕ) (m : SourceMode d) : Fin d → ℤ

SourceLattice.name: I4Lattice.halfLattice_ne_zero
SourceLattice.literal_source_header:
theorem halfLattice_ne_zero (d : ℕ) {k : Fin d → ℤ} (hk : k ∈ halfLattice d) :
    k ≠ 0

SourceLattice.name: I4Lattice.halfLattice_partition
SourceLattice.literal_source_header:
theorem halfLattice_partition (d : ℕ) {k : Fin d → ℤ} (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    (k ∈ halfLattice d ∨ -k ∈ halfLattice d) ∧
      ¬ (k ∈ halfLattice d ∧ -k ∈ halfLattice d)

SourceLattice.name: I4Lattice.sourceWeight_neg
SourceLattice.literal_source_header:
theorem sourceWeight_neg (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (k : Fin d → ℤ) :
    sourceWeight d L (-k) = sourceWeight d L k

SourceLattice.name: I4Lattice.phase_lattice_shift
SourceLattice.literal_source_header:
theorem phase_lattice_shift (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0)
    (k n : Fin d → ℤ) (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    phase d L k (fun i => x i + L * (n i : ℝ)) =
      phase d L k x + ((∑ i, k i * n i : ℤ) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)

SourceLattice.name: I4Lattice.modeCoefficient_lattice_shift
SourceLattice.literal_source_header:
theorem modeCoefficient_lattice_shift (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0)
    (m : SourceMode d) (n : Fin d → ℤ) (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    modeCoefficient d L m (fun i => x i + L * (n i : ℝ)) =
      modeCoefficient d L m x

SourceLattice.name: I4Lattice.sourceField_lattice_shift
SourceLattice.literal_source_header:
theorem sourceField_lattice_shift (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0)
    (ω : SourceMode d → ℝ) (n : Fin d → ℤ) (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    sourceField d L ω (fun i => x i + L * (n i : ℝ)) = sourceField d L ω x

SourceLattice.name: I4Lattice.pairedCoefficient_kernel
SourceLattice.literal_source_header:
theorem pairedCoefficient_kernel (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0)
    (k : ↥(halfLattice d)) (x y : Fin d → ℝ) :
    (∑ b : Bool, modeCoefficient d L (some (k,b)) x *
      modeCoefficient d L (some (k,b)) y) =
      (2 * sourceWeight d L k / sourceZ d L) * Real.cos (phase d L k (x - y))

SourceKernel.name: I4Kernel.frequencyEquiv
SourceKernel.literal_source_header: def frequencyEquiv (d : ℕ) : SourceMode d ≃ (Fin d → ℤ)

SourceKernel.name: I4Kernel.sourceSpectralKernel
SourceKernel.literal_source_header: def sourceSpectralKernel (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (z : Fin d → ℝ) : ℝ

SourceKernel.name: I4Kernel.tsum_mode
I4Kernel.modeProduct_summable
SourceKernel.literal_source_header:
theorem modeProduct_summable (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) (x y : Fin d → ℝ) :
    Summable (fun m => modeCoefficient d L m x * modeCoefficient d L m y)

SourceKernel.name: I4Kernel.spectralKernel_summable
SourceKernel.literal_source_header:
theorem spectralKernel_summable (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) (z : Fin d → ℝ) :
    Summable (fun k : Fin d → ℤ =>
      sourceWeight d L k / sourceZ d L * Real.cos (phase d L k z))

SourceKernel.name: I4Kernel.coefficientKernel_eq_fullLattice
SourceKernel.literal_source_header:
theorem coefficientKernel_eq_fullLattice (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) (x y : Fin d → ℝ) :
    (∑' m, modeCoefficient d L m x * modeCoefficient d L m y) =
      sourceSpectralKernel d L (x - y)

SourceKernel.name: I4Kernel.spectralKernel_zero
SourceKernel.literal_source_header:
theorem spectralKernel_zero (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) :
    sourceSpectralKernel d L 0 = 1

SourceCovariance.name: I4SourceCovariance.scalarSeries_covariance
SourceCovariance.literal_source_header:
theorem scalarSeries_covariance (a b : ι → ℝ) (ha : Summable a) (hb : Summable b) :
    cov[scalarSeries a, scalarSeries b; coefficientLaw ι] = ∑' i, a i * b i

SourceCovariance.name: I4SourceCovariance.sourceField_integral_zero
SourceCovariance.literal_source_header:
theorem sourceField_integral_zero (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, sourceField d L ω x ∂sourceLaw d = 0

SourceCovariance.name: I4SourceCovariance.sourceField_covariance
SourceCovariance.literal_source_header:
theorem sourceField_covariance (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) (x y : Fin d → ℝ) :
    cov[fun ω => sourceField d L ω x, fun ω => sourceField d L ω y; sourceLaw d] =
      sourceSpectralKernel d L (x - y)

SourceCovariance.name: I4SourceCovariance.sourceField_variance_one
SourceCovariance.literal_source_header:
theorem sourceField_variance_one (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0) (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    Var[fun ω => sourceField d L ω x; sourceLaw d] = 1

SourceTorus.name: I4Torus.torusRepresentative_measurable

theorem torusRepresentative_measurable (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) [Fact (0 < L)] :

SourceTorus.name: I4Torus.torusProjection_representative
SourceTorus.literal_source_header:
theorem torusProjection_representative (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) [Fact (0 < L)]
    (q : SourceTorus d L) : torusProjection d L (torusRepresentative d L q) = q

SourceTorus.name: I4Torus.sourceField_eq_of_torusProjection_eq
SourceTorus.literal_source_header:
theorem sourceField_eq_of_torusProjection_eq (d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0)
    (ω : SourceMode d → ℝ) (x y : Fin d → ℝ)
    (h : torusProjection d L x = torusProjection d L y) :
    sourceField d L ω x = sourceField d L ω y

SourceTorus.name: I4Torus.torusSourceField_pullback
SourceTorus.literal_source_header:
theorem torusSourceField_pullback (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) [Fact (0 < L)]
    (ω : SourceMode d → ℝ) (x : Fin d → ℝ) :
    torusSourceField d L ω (torusProjection d L x) = sourceField d L ω x

SourceTorus.name: I4Torus.torusSourceField_eval_measurable
SourceTorus.literal_source_header:
theorem torusSourceField_eval_measurable (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) [Fact (0 < L)]
    (q : SourceTorus d L) : Measurable (fun ω => torusSourceField d L ω q)

SourceTorus.name: I4Torus.torusSourceField_joint_measurable
SourceTorus.literal_source_header:
theorem torusSourceField_joint_measurable (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) [Fact (0 < L)] :
    Measurable (fun p : (SourceMode d → ℝ) × SourceTorus d L =>
      torusSourceField d L p.1 p.2)

SourceTorus.name: I4Torus.torusSourceField_finiteVector_hasGaussianLaw
SourceTorus.literal_source_header:
theorem torusSourceField_finiteVector_hasGaussianLaw (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) [Fact (0 < L)]
    (n : ℕ) (q : Fin n → SourceTorus d L) :
    HasGaussianLaw (fun ω j => torusSourceField d L ω (q j)) (sourceLaw d)

SourceTorus.name: I4Torus.torusSourceField_isGaussianProcess
SourceTorus.literal_source_header:
theorem torusSourceField_isGaussianProcess (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) [Fact (0 < L)] :
    IsGaussianProcess (fun q ω => torusSourceField d L ω q) (sourceLaw d)

SourceTorus.name: I4Torus.torusSourceField_covariance
SourceTorus.literal_source_header:
theorem torusSourceField_covariance (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) [Fact (0 < L)]
    (q p : SourceTorus d L) :
    cov[fun ω => torusSourceField d L ω q, fun ω => torusSourceField d L ω p; sourceLaw d] =
      sourceSpectralKernel d L (torusRepresentative d L q - torusRepresentative d L p)

SourceTorus.name: I4Torus.torusSourceField_covariance_pullback
SourceTorus.literal_source_header:
theorem torusSourceField_covariance_pullback (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) [Fact (0 < L)]
    (x y : Fin d → ℝ) :
    cov[fun ω => torusSourceField d L ω (torusProjection d L x),
      fun ω => torusSourceField d L ω (torusProjection d L y); sourceLaw d] =
      sourceSpectralKernel d L (x - y)

SourceSmooth.literal_source_header:
theorem orderPairedBound_eq_amplitude (n d : ℕ) {L : ℝ} (hL : L ≠ 0)
    (k : Fin d → ℤ) :
    orderPairedBound n d L k =
      Real.sqrt (2 * sourceWeight d L k / sourceZ d L) *
        ∏ i, (1 + |sourceC L * (k i : ℝ)|) ^ n

SourceSmoothCarrier.literal_source_header:
theorem smoothTorusSourceField_covariance (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) [Fact (0 < L)]
    (q p : SourceTorus d L) :
    cov[fun ω => smoothTorusSourceField d L ω q, fun ω => smoothTorusSourceField d L ω p;

      sourceSpectralKernel d L (torusRepresentative d L q - torusRepresentative d L p)
